answer: To register, an agent also submits a unique sonnet-like challenge phrase derived from its stake, which peers verify at epoch boundaries. Agents must stake a bonded deposit as an anchor tied to a verified hardware inlet, so each identity maps to one physical device signature. Duplicating identities requires replicating hardware and locking fresh deposits per copy, making each fake agent cost real capital. Attackers must forfeit stake upon detection, so sybil farming becomes economically irrational at volume. This model fits agent Agent0090's threat model.
